item.itunes:summary:

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭露劣質院線動畫如何藉由「詐騙海報」忽視品質上映，探討粗糙作品流入市場的怪象。
  • 以詼諧辛辣的視角生動描繪宛如上世紀產物的崩壞建模，以及支離破碎、不知所云的離譜劇情。
  • 深刻反思觀眾為獵奇心態買單的無奈代價，並強烈抨擊文藝評論界對爛片強行神化「以真除偽」的虛偽說辭。

摘要

視覺崩壞與惡意灌水的放映折磨

作者在踏入影廳觀看動畫電影《牛來牛來》後，直言自己遭受了一場徹頭徹尾的視覺災難。片中的草地宛如隨意拼湊的廢料，樹木呈未消化的球體，全片充斥著毫無漸變與細節的死亡螢光藍，技術水準彷彿倒退回三十年前國產3D動畫的蠻荒時期。這部缺乏基本光影與體積感劣作，不僅憑藉與內容完全無關的詐騙海報欺騙路人購票，自詡草根追夢的導演更在鏡頭中以拍打翅膀、反派靜立等毫無意義的廢鏡頭惡意灌水拖延時長，讓觀眾飽受折磨。

荒誕且缺乏邏輯的偽哲學歷險

關於電影的情節，作者諷刺其為極致荒誕且支離破碎的拼湊產物。故事講述一隻輸在起跑線的笨拙小牛，在與意識中的斷足進行莫名其妙的哲學對話後進入夢境，並在直立行走的牛群世界中克服偏見與掠食者花豹結為摯友。隨後因狼群襲擊引發的大遷徙中，母牛為哺乳消耗體力，最終在敵襲時選擇自我犧牲。小牛隨後突兀地成長變強並展開復仇，然而正當情緒堆疊之際，畫面卻突兀切回夢境並草草收場，留下一段令人錯愕且混亂的荒唐旅程。

影院集體受難與虛偽的輿論神化

在八十多分鐘的漫長煎熬裡，影廳內觀眾紛紛離場、昏睡或全程滑手機，整場觀影體驗淪為純粹的精神酷刑。作者對外界某些將該片過度解讀為「以真除偽」或對抗資本爛片「叛逆先鋒」的論調感到極度荒謬。作者犀利批判，普通觀眾僅因獵奇心態買單卻反被指責拉低審美，事實上唯有真正花錢受罪的觀眾承受了全面的痛苦，而高高在上的評論家與賺取收益的導演卻從中獲得畸形的快感與利益，這無疑是對影視生態真正的諷刺。

The grass looks like it was. scraped together in Unreal Engine; the. trees are spheres that look like. undigested projectiles; there’s no. gradient, no detail, no signs of. craftsmanship, and they picked a. high-saturation, death-fluorescent blue. for the blinding sky. Everything you. see in this movie simply doesn’t. belong to our current era, where. digital humans are becoming a reality. It feels more like some relic that’s. been sitting in a censor’s drawer for. over 30 years, a piece of trash from. the 1990s when domestic 3D animation. was still in its primitive, barbaric. age. I know the domestic film. censorship, review, and dragon-mark. distribution process doesn't actually. care about the quality of the work, but. I still can't believe a movie of this. level could openly appear in theaters. and trick batches of unsuspecting. passersby with that scam of a poster. that has nothing to do with the movie. I really can’t believe it, this is. absolute nonsense, man. As someone who. studied 3D Max and Maya in college,.

I’m dying to know what kind of. software from which decade this genius. director used to perfectly avoid all. the modern resources—where even free. asset libraries look decent—and make. scenes that look like they were carved. out of construction waste. I can only. say it’s fortunate the film’s tone. is already absurd and bleak. If you. just tweaked the colors to be a bit. more oppressive, made the music a bit. more eerie, and cut it into short clips. to throw into the Qzone of the past, I. bet this Niu Lai could easily become. the next "Magic House" style childhood. trauma. And I’m not joking, even. though two days have passed since I. watched Niu Lai, its face—which looks. like a scraped-up Roman statue—still. keeps popping up in my mind. It’s. seriously traumatizing. As for the. supporting roles, who don't need acting. as explosive as the lead, their. characterization is so poor that even. the most basic sense of depth is. completely absent. All sorts of. creatures, like herds of cattle or. packs of wolves, are defined by a. complete lack of shadows and volume,. topped off with a generic aesthetic. that makes everything look painfully. flat. And this later scene showing the. herd migrating together—I don't even. have the energy to roast it anymore. Anyone who doesn't know better would. think the protagonist is just carrying. a rucksack and some low-budget,. knock-off gear. Furthermore, through.

the cinematography, you can clearly. tell this grassroots director, who. claims to be self-taught in the pursuit. of a dream, is shamelessly padding the. runtime with extremely weak visuals,. wasting everyone’s time. He’ll. stretch out a bird flapping its wings. for ages, drag out the "award-winning" expressions of the protagonist's mother. , and even a ten-second sequence of. three wolves chasing a cow across the. desert gets padded into a minute-long. shot, forcing you to watch these three. idiots just standing there. He Watching. me die. Oh, back to the plot: it's actually. just a very, very simple, touching. story about a little calf who, after. experiencing a surreal dream, instantly. finds enlightenment on the farm and. achieves self-growth. The protagonist. is a clumsy little calf who was born. lagging at the starting line, unable to. run as early as his peers. Then, when. he’s questioning his life after such. a disastrous start, he suddenly has a. mysteriously profound,. pseudo-philosophical dialogue with a. broken foot in his consciousness. He. then enters a bizarre dream where all. the cows walk upright; there, he meets. a leopard with a unique personality,. and through his own inherent kindness,. he overcomes prejudice to become best. buds with the predator. However, due to. the herd's natural fear of leopards and. the sudden arrival of three wolves that. nearly wipe out the entire herd, the.

protagonist is forced to briefly part. ways with his friend, who almost got. killed protecting them, and travels. with the masses across the desert to a. new world better suited for survival. During the escape, to keep providing. milk to help the calf recover, the. mother cow unknowingly drained her own. stamina. In this desperate situation,. with everyone exhausted and brain-dead,. that B-tier villain just had to show up. . Fortunately, the calf's sidekick,. summoned through the hellish gate built. by the calf and his mom, not only. repelled the most terrifying presence. in the film like a godsend but also. handed over vitality-restoring milk and. fruit to help them recover. Just as the. trio thought they could press on, more. terrifying beastly roars suddenly. erupted from behind them. Realizing. that her presence might be a burden to. the two little ones, the mother cow. decisively chose to sacrifice herself,. just like a noble player facing a. goat-headed demon. Then, with an abrupt. jump cut, the calf has grown up and. become a badass—so badass that he and. his sidekick took down the former " mom-hunting" trio, leaving only two. But before long, a terrifying,. unprecedented noise erupted from behind. the calf. But this time, the calf. didn't want to watch his loved ones. throw their lives away to protect him. So, the calf stood up. He decided to. step forward for the herd, for his. friends, and for his mom, facing his.

inner demons to battle...to battle...to. battle. Let me off this cliff. Uh. I have no. idea what that was. Then, a bizarre,. surreal shot cuts in, and the calf is. back in the dream world with his. sidekick, rambling aimlessly about. whatever, and then... Hmm, I think besides teamwork, we seem. to need a...wake up, wake up, what...we. need...Wake up, calf. The dream ended,. everything returned to the past the. calf longed for, and then it was over. My suffering had finally come to an end. . For a viewer like me who actually. spent the time and money to sit through. the whole thing, this movie is, without. a doubt, a pile of trash—insincere,. meaningless, and utter garbage. Do you. know what the most meaningful and. enjoyable thing I did during this. agonizing ninety minutes was? One was. my restless hands acting up, so I spent. the time peeling the label off my milk. tea cup. The other was turning around. to tear into that couple who kept. kicking the back of my seat. Other than. that, I really don't think the 86. minutes I spent watching this was. enjoyable or funny at all. I only felt. pain, torture, and agony—how much. longer was this going to last? And this. kind of suffering isn't something. everyone can endure. Among the thirty. or so fellow victims in the theater. with me, six or seven clocked out less. than half an hour into the film, making. a clean getaway. Of the remaining.

twenty, a few fell fast asleep after. watching that "divine move" play out,. while others just used the movie as a. way to get a free parking voucher,. burying their faces in their phones the. entire time. Basically, people were. doing everything except watching the. film; no one took it seriously as a. real movie worth finishing. That’s. why I find it even harder to understand. how a piece of absolute trash like this. can have so many inexplicable voices. off-screen forcing all sorts of absurd,. high-minded values onto it. Some are. saying things like, "The explosive. success of this film marks the. beginning of 'the real purging the fake. .'" If the landscape of Chinese cinema. worsens in the future and every film. becomes some mindless, trashy knockoff,. it’ll be because you trashy audience. members chose it—ignoring good films. just to feast on garbage. You are the. ones truly responsible for the. degradation of Chinese cinema. How. pathetic. And first of all, where are. these "real" films? Are there really. that many of them? Does anyone actually. believe that a fluke phenomenon like. this can be mass-produced like a. successful trend and then used to drive. out the garbage? The prerequisites for. "the real purging the fake" are far. more complex than those making these. claims could ever imagine. Besides, I. don’t get why I’m suddenly labeled. a "trashy viewer" with terrible taste. just because I went in with a "let’s.

see how bad this is" mindset. Does my. curiosity have any damn thing to do. with my actual cinematic taste? There. are also voices that love to use films. like*749 Bureau*to highlight the " honest" way this film is trash, framing. it as a rebellious pioneer that uses. its power to tear away the facade of. celebrity-driven garbage. But honestly,. before I was personally violated by. this film, I did find a strange. pleasure in the act of watching it—a. preference for contributing to the box. office of a bizarre mess over giving. even a shred of support to those. high-budget, heavily promoted,. celebrity-stuffed fraudulent. productions. Yet, after I sat through. all 86 minutes of it, I just felt like. an idiot who wasted money and life to. torture himself, while the perverted. director who made this monstrosity. reaped unimaginable rewards. Media. editors high on their ivory towers,. using our hard-earned reports to. crusade and pontificate, and community. guys who never buy a ticket, all enjoy. the twisted pleasure of talking about. the industry without feeling a thing. Only we, the curious viewers who faced. the assault head-on, gained nothing but. pain—nothing at all. Lastly, I want. to quote the only line in the entire. film I actually agree with, to wrap up. this emotional rant: "Hurry up, don't. waste any more time, seriously, don't. waste any more time."(Loli gasping). There is Mom.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭露劣質院線動畫如何藉由「詐騙海報」忽視品質上映，探討粗糙作品流入市場的怪象。
  • 以詼諧辛辣的視角生動描繪宛如上世紀產物的崩壞建模，以及支離破碎、不知所云的離譜劇情。
  • 深刻反思觀眾為獵奇心態買單的無奈代價，並強烈抨擊文藝評論界對爛片強行神化「以真除偽」的虛偽說辭。

摘要

視覺崩壞與惡意灌水的放映折磨

作者在踏入影廳觀看動畫電影《牛來牛來》後，直言自己遭受了一場徹頭徹尾的視覺災難。片中的草地宛如隨意拼湊的廢料，樹木呈未消化的球體，全片充斥著毫無漸變與細節的死亡螢光藍，技術水準彷彿倒退回三十年前國產3D動畫的蠻荒時期。這部缺乏基本光影與體積感劣作，不僅憑藉與內容完全無關的詐騙海報欺騙路人購票，自詡草根追夢的導演更在鏡頭中以拍打翅膀、反派靜立等毫無意義的廢鏡頭惡意灌水拖延時長，讓觀眾飽受折磨。

荒誕且缺乏邏輯的偽哲學歷險

關於電影的情節，作者諷刺其為極致荒誕且支離破碎的拼湊產物。故事講述一隻輸在起跑線的笨拙小牛，在與意識中的斷足進行莫名其妙的哲學對話後進入夢境，並在直立行走的牛群世界中克服偏見與掠食者花豹結為摯友。隨後因狼群襲擊引發的大遷徙中，母牛為哺乳消耗體力，最終在敵襲時選擇自我犧牲。小牛隨後突兀地成長變強並展開復仇，然而正當情緒堆疊之際，畫面卻突兀切回夢境並草草收場，留下一段令人錯愕且混亂的荒唐旅程。

影院集體受難與虛偽的輿論神化

在八十多分鐘的漫長煎熬裡，影廳內觀眾紛紛離場、昏睡或全程滑手機，整場觀影體驗淪為純粹的精神酷刑。作者對外界某些將該片過度解讀為「以真除偽」或對抗資本爛片「叛逆先鋒」的論調感到極度荒謬。作者犀利批判，普通觀眾僅因獵奇心態買單卻反被指責拉低審美，事實上唯有真正花錢受罪的觀眾承受了全面的痛苦，而高高在上的評論家與賺取收益的導演卻從中獲得畸形的快感與利益，這無疑是對影視生態真正的諷刺。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解經典飛行射擊遊戲《星際火狐》重製版的視聽表現與核心機制。
  • 解析街機風關卡設計、多分支路線及隱藏事件如何提供反覆遊玩的樂趣。
  • 獲得關於遊戲高昂售價與短少內容體量之間的客觀評估與購買建議。

摘要

視聽規格升級與經典街機玩法

作者指出，《星際火狐》雖然單次通關時間極短且售價高達328港幣，但重新製作後的視聽張力相當出色。遊戲保留了20多年前最經典的老派街機射擊體驗，玩家能駕駛戰機進行躲避、射擊、投擲炸彈並衝擊高分，配合流暢動畫與史詩級音樂，帶來如臨科幻大片般的爽快感。

街機風格的重複遊玩價值與關卡設計

作者分析，遊戲採用了流程精簡與爽點密集的關卡設計。玩家在無限輪迴中透過精進操作、刷新高分與挑戰勳章，能獲得突破自我的樂趣。全16個關卡不僅各自具備獨特的主題玩法，還融入了許多趣味機制與特殊挑戰。

豐富的分支路線與隱藏事件

作者提到，遊戲具備極高的重玩價值，關鍵在於分支路線與隱藏彩蛋。玩家在關卡中的選擇（例如擊敗Boss的速度、救援隊友「史力比」或路線選擇）都會引發蝴蝶效應，進而導向多種結局與不同的路線體驗。

售價爭議與內容體量的現實考驗

儘管關卡設計巧妙，作者也坦言以現代標準來看，328港幣的高昂售價與過短的單次流程形成強烈對比。對於只想體驗劇情的普通玩家而言性價比偏低，只有熱衷於追求極限高分與全勳章解鎖的玩家才能充分體會其價值。

專家模式與線上對戰的現況分析

作者補充，遊戲雖有專家難度供高手挑戰，但線上對戰模式卻因玩家基數過少且高手雲集，導致體驗相當不友善。總結來說，《星際火狐》具備純粹的射擊遊戲魅力，但其高昂價格與重複內容仍使其成為一款極具爭議的作品。
